summary.title: SecureNova AI Identity Security
summary.description: SecureNova Inc. operates an AI-powered customer service platform using Auth0 for identity management. Authenticated human users interact with an AI agent that invokes internal REST APIs, retrieves knowledge through a RAG pipeline, and calls MCP server tools. The platform contains human and non-human identities including users, AI agents, OAuth M2M clients, LLM API keys, RAG service identities, and MCP server identities. The threat model evaluates authentication, authorization, credential exposure, identity spoofing, privilege escalation, prompt injection, RAG poisoning, and audit risks.
